subject: TOURN: Special Event set to dynamic scoring but has no dynamicConfig - decay never fires
description: The live 'Special Event' tournament has scoringModel=dynamic and NO dynamicConfig field. functions/index.js:7097 guards the decay branch on both, so it never runs: every solve awards flat static points forever, silently. The board still shows points so nobody would notice. Fix: write dynamicConfig at creation when scoringModel=dynamic, or refuse to save that combination.
